You missed your flight, and you were furious.
Sometimes, what feels like bad luck is actually protection.
You didn't get the job you wanted.
Six months later, the company shut down.
And you missed the pile-up on the motorway.
And made room for someone who actually stays.
And it taught you what winning never could.
Not every door that closes is a punishment. Some of them are saving you.
So stop asking, why me? And start saying, thank you.
And next time something goes wrong, remember,
